walkthroughReviewer: Fable review seat (agent), a different agent from the author
purpose: Supplements the C22 walkthrough, whose template-edit check only changed the template description and the Matter Manager. This run edits the template's actual content and shows that an already-created Matter keeps its copied rows while a fresh Matter receives the new content.

fixture.owned: Author-created lab fixture in the conversations lab; not an immutable deployment input
fixture.editsApplied: Task 1 title → 'Rev edited evidence <stamp>' and dueOffsetDays 3 → 5; Key date 2 label → 'Rev edited checkpoint <stamp>' and offsetDays 7 → 9; counts unchanged
fixture.restoration: After each role's run the Administrator's API session replaced the Tasks and Key dates with the saved content; the read-back equalled the saved copy on title, offset, assignee role, label, note and display order. Row identifiers were reissued by the replace endpoints. The same restoration ran again in the script's final step.

frontend: The conversations lab at port 43302; each reader role's own browser session for the Create dialog and the Tasks and Key dates tabs; the Administrator's API session only for the template edit and its restoration, recorded as separate fixture steps
browser: Playwright 1.62.1 driving the installed Chromium 1243 build, headless, one isolated context per role at 1280×1800 CSS px; scripts written by the reviewer
limitations: The template edit and restoration were made through the API by the Administrator as reviewer fixture setup; this is not acceptance of the DOC-021 administrator guide on Matter templates.
Independent agent walkthrough; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
Only the single-template type was exercised; the alpha/beta templates of the multi type were not edited.

steps.step: Use a template: a Matter created from the single template before any template edit copies the current Task and Key date content
steps.actual: M-132 created from "Docs Matter single playbook 1788804353434" ("Template adds 2 tasks and 2 key dates."): Tasks "Review single evidence" due 2026-09-10, "Arrange single discussion" due none; Key dates "Fictional single start" 2026-09-07, "Fictional single checkpoint" 2026-09-14

steps.step: Fixture setup by the Administrator's API session for the administrator run: replace the single template's Tasks and Key dates with an edited Task title/offset and an edited Key date label/offset
steps.actual: PUT /matter-templates/01a07d0c-53aa-74ea-bd56-7190de43b1d1/tasks and /key-dates answered 200/200; the template now has Task 1 "Rev edited evidence 1788808864851" at +5 (was "Review single evidence" at +3) and Key date 2 "Rev edited checkpoint 1788808864851" at +9 (was "Fictional single checkpoint" at +7); counts still 2 and 2. This is reviewer fixture setup through the owned lab template, not DOC-021 administrator-guide acceptance.
